assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: production environment illustration for a Chinese browser life-strategy game, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: create a beautifully art-directed, semi-realistic cinematic illustration of a modest rented urban Chinese apartment in early 2020. It should feel like a personal life is about to begin again, grounded and quietly hopeful.
Scene/backdrop: lived-in small study beside a window looking onto ordinary low-rise city apartments, soft overcast morning light outside, warm small desk lamp inside. Ordinary unbranded laptop, notebook with blank pages, plain ceramic cup, bills with no legible writing. No people, so no imposed gender or identity.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted cinematic game environment with believable materials, restrained fine texture, clear shapes, natural perspective; not a glossy real-estate photograph and not anime.
Composition/framing: wide eye-level composition, desk and window form a strong scene on the right, calmer shadowed wall on the left provides usable negative space for HTML title. The lower area must also allow cropping into a short chapter banner. A coherent real room, not a collage.
Lighting/mood: cool daylight balanced with amber lamplight, subtle atmospheric depth, humane and intimate.
Color palette: warm off-white plaster, weathered walnut, charcoal, muted rain-blue outdoors, restrained amber accent.
Text: none. No letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI panel, chart, border or button in the illustration.
Constraints: historically plausible ordinary 2020 belongings; no futuristic displays, robots, luxury office or speculative AI hardware. Empty room, no character portrait. The image is a visual background; all game information will be rendered separately as accessible HTML.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop interface design reference for a Chinese life-strategy game "重生2020：AI时代", wide 16:9 screenshot of the application itself.
Primary request: design an elegant, genuinely game-like quarterly workbench. A restrained semi-realistic cinematic room photograph/painting is a shallow chapter banner at the top, while the actual playable interface is a beautifully typeset warm ivory paper workspace. It must feel like opening a life journal in an ordinary Chinese apartment in 2020, not an enterprise analytics dashboard.
Composition/framing: coherent single 1440x900-style desktop screen, no device frame. Slim top wordmark and four navigation items. A short scene banner with large 2020 year and quiet chapter title, warm lamplight/cool window atmosphere. Below, a large editorial left column for one meaningful decision, a compact right column for upcoming obligations and dates. Generous readable spacing, subtle rules and paper edge, sophisticated Chinese serif headings, crisp modern body type. Brass/umber buttons, charcoal text, small muted rain-blue timeline. Avoid a sea of equally sized rounded cards.
Exact key text only, verbatim: "重生2020" ; "本季" ; "经营" ; "记忆" ; "账本" ; "2020 · 第一季度" ; "重新安排你的时间" ; "可花现金" ; "¥26,000" ; "剩余行动" ; "4 / 4" ; "保留工作，也做一点自己的事" ; "工作 · 2点" ; "手工第一单 · 1点" ; "查看安排" ; "本季承诺" ; "生活费 ¥4,000 / 月" ; "一切还可以重新选择".
Use restrained horizontal progress marks and a quiet timeline as visual hierarchy, no pie charts or fabricated financial gains. Make the personal cash balance visibly different from speculative opportunity information.
Constraints: all interface text is a design reference, not final raster UI; the real game will render accessible HTML controls. No extra invented logos, characters, futuristic hardware, sci-fi HUD, neon, fake charts, colossal sidebar, watermark or microtext clutter. No promise of stock returns. No real company trademarks. Cinematic environment should support the clear light workspace rather than darken the entire screen.
